defs.def: at or to a higher place or position than sth/sb 在（或向）… 上面

ex.s: In a matrix garden, plants with similar cultural needs are grouped so that they will grow together above and below ground, forming a cooperative ecosystem that conserves water and discourages weeds.
ex.t: 在矩阵花园中，养护需求相似的植物被组合在一起，使它们在地上地下共同生长，形成一个节约用水、抑制杂草的协作生态系统。

ex.s: Eva spent the first week of high school trying to keep her head above water.
ex.t: 伊娃高中第一周都在努力应付（不让自己被淹没）。

ex.s: Because the moon’s body blocks direct radio communication with a probe, China first had to put a satellite in orbit above the moon in a spot   63   it could send signals to the spacecraft and to Earth.
ex.t: 由于月球本体阻挡了与探测器的直接无线电通信，中国必须先在月球上方轨道上的一个___63___能将信号发往航天器和地球的位置部署一颗卫星。

ex.s: There, among many other things, Nicolo spotted two paintings he thought would look ___45___above his dining room table.
ex.t: 在那里，尼科洛在许多东西中发现了两幅他认为挂在餐桌上方会很好看的画。

ex.s: He hung them above the same table he had ___48___ from Turin.
ex.t: 他把它们挂在那张他从都灵____48____来的桌子上方。

ex.s: No area was spared or unaffected, from the foggy northern coast to the Sierra Nevada Mountains to the San Gabriels above Los Angeles.
ex.t: 从多雾的北部海岸，到内华达山脉，再到洛杉矶上方的圣加布里埃尔山，没有哪个地区幸免或不受影响。

ex.s: A．at firstB．after allC．above allD．at random
ex.t: A．at firstB．after allC．above allD．at random

ex.s: (You can see how that works in the video above.) The strips of red, white, and black shells all come from Langa Langa Lagoon, where artificial islands were long-ago built by locals to escape from the island-dwelling cannibals.
ex.t: （你可以在上面的视频中看到它是如何运作的。）红、白、黑相间的贝壳条都来自兰加兰加泻湖，当地人很久以前就在那里建造人工岛以躲避岛上的食人族。

ex.s: One of the interesting ways the study of economics relates to human behavior generally is that a lot of economic theory is the formalization of the kind of simple concept outlined above — a consumer's informal understanding of the amount she has to spend and what that amount will buy.
ex.t: 经济学研究与一般人类行为相关的一个有趣之处是，许多经济理论是对上述简单概念——消费者对可花费金额及该金额能买到什么的非正式理解——的形式化。

ex.s: Any combination above it is not.
ex.t: 高于它的任何组合都不行。

ex.s: It ran for just under seven kilometers and allowed people to avoid terrible __61__ (crowd) on the roads above as they travelled to and ___62__ word.
ex.t: 它运行了不到七公里，让人们在上方的道路上前往和____62____（word）时避开可怕的____61__（crowd）人群。

ex.s: In 1863the first underground passenger railway in the world opened in London. z&xxk It ran for just under seven kilometers and allowed people to avoid terrible __61__(crowd) on the roads above as they travelled to and ___62__ word.
ex.t: 1863年，世界上第一条地下客运铁路在伦敦开通。它运行了不到七公里，让人们在上方道路上前往和____62__（word）时避开可怕的__61__（crowd）人群。

ex.s: Nobody is quite sure, but poor diet and above all long-time alcoholism have much to do with it.
ex.t: 没人十分确定，但不良饮食，尤其是长期酗酒，与之关系很大。

ex.s: Background information In Britain, the floor of a building at the bottom level is called the "ground floor" and the floor above it is called the "first floor".
ex.t: 背景信息：在英国，建筑物最底层的楼层叫“ground floor（底层）”，它上面的一层叫“first floor（一楼）”。

ex.s: In America, just like in China, the "first floor" is at the bottom level and the one above it is the "second floor".
ex.t: 在美国，就像在中国一样，“first floor（一楼）”在最底层，它上面的一层是“second floor（二楼）”。

defs.def: more than sth; greater in number, level or age than sb/sth （数目、数量、水平、年龄）超过，多于，大于

ex.s: The low point of the sheet must be centered directly over, and no more than three inches above, the cup.
ex.t: 塑料布的最低点必须正好对准杯子中心，且高出杯子不超过三英寸。

ex.s: The peak of Mount Qomolangma, 8,849 meters above sea level.
ex.t: 珠穆朗玛峰峰顶，海拔8849米。

ex.s: In my early thirties, I decided to climb Mount Kilimanjaro, the highest mountain in Africa at 5, 895 meters above sea level.
ex.t: 三十岁出头时，我决定攀登非洲最高峰、海拔5895米的乞力马扎罗山。

ex.s: This same dot appears at the extreme left above “0” on the horizontal axis because you have no money left for books — the number of books available in this example is 0.
ex.t: 这个点在横轴上“0”的最左端上方出现，因为你已没有钱买书——此例中可买的书数量为0。

ex.s: The South-east Ridge Route on Qomolangma SUMMIT: 8,844m DEATH ZONE 8,000 m above sea level Only 30% as much oxygen as available at sea level.
ex.t: 珠峰东南山脊路线 顶峰：8844米 死亡地带 海拔8000米 只有海平面含氧量的30%。

ex.s: The results are mixed For football and basketball，adding talented players to a team proves a good method，but only up to the point where 70% of the players are top talent；above that level, the team’s performance begins to decline.
ex.t: 结果好坏参半：对足球和篮球，给球队增加天才球员被证明是好方法，但仅到70%球员为顶尖人才为止；超过这一水平，球队表现开始下滑。

defs.def: of greater importance or of higher quality than sb/sth （重要性、质量）超过，胜过

ex.s: While taking a 20-hour train ride along the edge of the Taklimakan Desert in northwestern China, I had the kind of humbling, educational, and above all else, wonderful   41   with a local that all travelers long for.
ex.t: 在中国西北塔克拉玛干沙漠边缘搭乘20小时的火车时，我与一位当地人有了那种令人谦卑、富有教益，而最重要的是美妙的（第41空）经历，这是所有旅行者都向往的。

ex.s: And above all, stories have a transformative power to allow us to see the world in a different way than we do if we just encounter it on our own.
ex.t: 而最重要的是，故事具有一种变革性的力量，让我们以不同于独自面对世界的方式去看待它。

ex.s: Above all, I hoped he wouldn't assign me to work with the fiercely competitive, extremely serious fellow who always wore dark clothes and apparently had a personality to match.
ex.t: 最重要的是，我希望他不会把我分配给那个竞争心极强、极其严肃、总是穿深色衣服、而且显然性格也与之相称的家伙。

defs.def: too good or too honest to do sth （因善良或诚实正直而）不至于，不屑于（做某事）
louder or clearer than another sound 声音
at or to a higher place 在（或向）上面；在（或向）较高处
greater in number, level or age （数目、数量、水平、年龄）超过，更多，更大
earlier in sth written or printed 上文；前文

ex.s: The majority of people with Alzheimer’s are 65 and above.
ex.t: 大多数阿尔茨海默病患者是65岁及以上。

ex.s: Above me was the calm surface of the sea.
ex.t: 我上方是平静的海面。
